scope: extended-chain and N-substituted cathinones; no pyros; no MMC/CMC tutorial wall; no bk-MDMA; no opioids; no recipes/doses
score_legend: 0-100 or null. Pleasure and compulsiveness scored independently. Confidence A (strongest) to U (name-only).

substances.name: N-ethylnorpentedrone
substances.one_liner: If it lasts till noon, it wasn’t 3-MMC.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: mid, not hexen’s punch — observational onset inside 20 min, gone 3–4 h; forum split between ‘almost no rush’ and ‘too rushy when greedy.’ EUPHORIA: coke-plus-a-little-body-glow, ‘clean’ in the Goldilocks zone, not a 4-MMC hug; observational liking beat hexen. COMPULSIVENESS: the real score. People who hate it still stay up 36 hours; vape talk makes it worse; sold as 3-MMC so the bag outlives the night. ENJOYMENT: brilliant coke alternative to some, anxiety-then-keep-going to others.
substances.negatives_writeup: Psychotic wiggle and paranoia after the session overstays. ‘No comedown’ reports sit next to binge wreckage. Heart rate and blood pressure jump in the only human observational; palpitations in Erowid. Sleep is the product you didn’t ask for.

rush.rationale: Faster on/off than hexen in Núñez-Montero 2025; forum rush weaker than hexen.

euphoria.rationale: Observational VAS liking +72 mm; Erowid coke/MDMA-body; Bluelight glow then Goldilocks-or-psychosis.

compulsiveness.rationale: Hated-it-but-36-hours reports; EUDA + fora binge/redose; independent of pleasure.

enjoyment.rationale: Split: ‘brilliant’ vs ‘anxiety first.’ Observational bad-effects +40 mm.

sociability.rationale: Top observational VAS were open/close/want-people; Erowid conversations; also hermit-mode forums.

paranoia.rationale: Bluelight psychotic wiggle / forgetfulness past the Goldilocks zone.

aftereffects.rationale: Some ‘non-existent comedown’; binge reports are a wreck.

cardiovascular.rationale: Observational SBP +21 / HR +22; Erowid palpitations; 63 EU deaths with exposure.

sleep.rationale: All-nighter chemistry; 36-hour sessions in forum record.

sources.title: EUDA POD injection of synthetic cathinones

substances.name: N-ethylhexedrone
substances.one_liner: Coke’s ugly twin who still steals the night.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: the coke comparison. First bump can ring; observational onset inside 20 min, a hair slower than NEP at peak but forum rush sits higher. EUPHORIA: ‘perfect euphoric stimulant if you have perfect discipline’; redoses go cold and jittery. COMPULSIVENESS: rat-in-a-box. Stronger fiend than NEP in the old head-to-head. ENJOYMENT: high on bump one, collapses if the night continues. Loved-it / crushed-me is not a contradiction.
substances.negatives_writeup: Best-dope-worst-comedown is the Erowid title that stuck. Paranoia and psychosis after a binge. SBP/HR jump in observational; fatal and non-fatal case pile. Sleep is gone. Nose-damage folklore is not a recipe.

rush.rationale: Bluelight coke-rush consensus; slam talk exists as flag only.

euphoria.rationale: First-dose love; observational liking lower than NEP; redoses flatten.

compulsiveness.rationale: Explicit ‘I know I don’t need it and I still bump’ reports; stronger than NEP.

sociability.rationale: Functional then messy; observational empathy softer than NEP.

substances.name: Pentedrone
substances.one_liner: Coffee with a criminal record.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: functional, not cinematic; a few old voices liked a flooring music-glow. EUPHORIA: work-stim, no hug. COMPULSIVENESS: redose exists, not hexen. ENJOYMENT: useful, rarely beloved.
substances.negatives_writeup: Cold grind. Cardiovascular risk is the forensic story, not the party. Hungarian injector rotation after each ban is a slam_flag, not a how-to.

rush.rationale: Functional; some Erowid ‘flooring,’ most later heads say cold.

paranoia.rationale: Class stim, thinner record than NEP.

substances.name: Hexedrone
substances.one_liner: Hexen’s N-methyl dad. Same clothes, less party.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: shorter, flatter push than hexen. EUPHORIA: one-dimensional. COMPULSIVENESS: present, not legendary. ENJOYMENT: filler on the wall. Isomer of NEP — labs mix them up.
substances.negatives_writeup: Thin forum record. Treat as weaker hexen, not a second review of hexen.

rush.rationale: Poland 2013 notification; thin feel vs hexen.

euphoria.rationale: Flatter than hexen in the little that exists.

compulsiveness.rationale: Class redose, not a fat thread.

sources.title: EUDA POD hexedrone first Poland Jul 2013

substances.name: N-butylhexedrone
substances.one_liner: They kept adding carbons after the fun left.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: no usable feel corpus. UK detections only.
substances.negatives_writeup: Forensic tick. Do not invent a review.

rush.rationale: UK ACMD 11 detections; no feel record.

substances.name: N-ethylheptedrone
substances.one_liner: Energy and a skip in the chest. Sold as six other things.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: energy, not a famous punch. EUPHORIA: confidence bump in the WHO self-report pile, not a hug. COMPULSIVENESS: inferred from class + mislabel binge, not a fat thread. ENJOYMENT: agitation sits next to the energy.
substances.negatives_writeup: Irregular heartbeat and agitation in the ECDD review. One post-mortem, medium contribution. Sold as NEP, meth, MDMA, cocaine, benzos, even a hydrocodone stamp.

rush.rationale: WHO: energy; DAT/NET strong on paper, thin lived rush talk.

cardiovascular.rationale: Irregular heartbeat in WHO self-reports; DAT/NET profile.

substances.name: Buphedrone
substances.one_liner: 2009 net ghost. Mephedrone’s shorter-chain cousin who never got famous.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: short. EUPHORIA: SOFT says forums claim mephedrone-like and also contradict themselves. COMPULSIVENESS: compulsive redose common in that monograph. ENJOYMENT: conflicting. About two hours in the forum summary — duration flag, not a dose.
substances.negatives_writeup: Metabolites overlap NEB and alpha-PBP, so urine stories lie. No published human tox in the SOFT sheet.

substances.name: N-ethylbuphedrone
substances.one_liner: 4-MEC’s isomer. Denmark mail, 2011. Never a star.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: thin. Do not steal 4-MEC’s reviews. Isomer of 4-MEC, pentedrone, 3,4-DMMC.
substances.negatives_writeup: Polish tox: two cases, modest blood levels. Forensic more than folklore.

substances.name: 4-methylethcathinone
substances.one_liner: You can go to work. You will hate work.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: Erowid four-cathinone study — intense almost-panic onset that then leaves almost nothing; other reports a short coke-adjacent kick. EUPHORIA: WHO user-report analysis — less intense and shorter than mephedrone; some ‘rolly,’ some ‘junk.’ COMPULSIVENESS: WHO says conflicting; one Erowid kept lining, the four-cathinone author said boosters did nothing. Score the conflict, don’t flatten it. ENJOYMENT: diet meow. Fun, short, burn.
substances.negatives_writeup: Sweating, nausea, jaw, nystagmus, palpitations, migraine in the WHO list. Some claim no comedown. Paris syringe residue 2012 is a slam_flag, not SOP. Branded legal-high constituent.

rush.rationale: Panic-onset then nothing (Erowid four-cathinones); short kick elsewhere.

euphoria.rationale: WHO: less than mephedrone; split rolly/junk.

compulsiveness.rationale: WHO conflict + Erowid 99725 binge vs dead boosters.

aftereffects.rationale: WHO ‘lack of comedown’ vs high-oral wreck.

substances.name: 3-methylethcathinone
substances.one_liner: The other MEC. One UK tick. Don’t write it a novel.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: no feel corpus. DEA positional isomer of the pentedrone/4-MEC cluster.
substances.negatives_writeup: Forensic only.

substances.name: Ethcathinone
substances.one_liner: The quiet winner in one Erowid four-way. Nasty if you get greedy.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: subtle, not a slam. EUPHORIA: the four-cathinone author called modest insufflated amounts the clear winner — energy plus empathogenic clarity. COMPULSIVENESS: easy top-up; ugly when the pile grows. ENJOYMENT: high when small, sketched when large. SOCIABILITY is the actual selling point in that report.
substances.negatives_writeup: Bigger oral nights: jaw, hollow gut, couch-lock, surprisingly nasty comedown. Do not overweight a single long Erowid.

euphoria.rationale: One long Erowid is glowing; keep the range wide.

substances.name: 4-ethylmethcathinone
substances.one_liner: The closest 4-MMC copy some old heads will still admit to.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: present, not hexen. EUPHORIA: Bluelight ‘closest thing to 4-MMC I have had’; old reddit ‘rolly, monged, incredibly euphoric depending on your tastes’ and ‘sedating, mushy, rolly — one of my favs.’ COMPULSIVENESS: below meow. ENJOYMENT: actually liked, unlike most of this wall.
substances.negatives_writeup: Not a current flood. Sweden May 2011 first hit. Do not pretend it is 4-MMC.

euphoria.rationale: Strongest meow-adjacent claim on this wall besides 4-MEC’s hope.

substances.name: 4-ethylethcathinone
substances.one_liner: Same formula as NEP. Different sticker. Almost no reviews.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: Cayman says physiological effects have not been characterized. EUDA monitors it as an NEP isomer.
substances.negatives_writeup: Isomer collision risk. Do not score a fantasy.

substances.name: 4-chloroethcathinone
substances.one_liner: Energy Control found five bags. Forums already hated the halogen.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: weak. EUPHORIA: Bluelight guessed junk before anyone had much; that guess stuck. COMPULSIVENESS: low-mid. ENJOYMENT: thin copies. UK detections later proved it shipped.
substances.negatives_writeup: Para-chloro neurotoxin rumor follows the family — rumor, not a lecture. Rat work: milder CV than 4-CMC. Energy Control: 23% of bought cathinone samples were what the buyer asked for.

substances.name: 3-chloroethcathinone
substances.one_liner: One UK tick. Empty chair.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: none on record.
substances.negatives_writeup: Forensic only.

substances.name: 4-methylpentedrone
substances.one_liner: The name on the bag. Check the other card.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: dull. EUPHORIA: Cartiser’s forum scrape — ‘worthless as a stim.’ COMPULSIVENESS: chemsex fatality implies redose risk, not love. ENJOYMENT: low. Real molecule (Czech 2014) and also the most lied-about name on this wall.
substances.negatives_writeup: Lyon chemsex death with cocaine. Vendor 2013 ‘4-MPD’ was 4-MEAP. Keep identity separate.

substances.name: 4-methyl-alpha-ethylaminopentiophenone
substances.one_liner: The bag said 4-MPD. The crystal said N-ethyl.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA: contaminated by the name swap — treat as 4-methyl-NEP, not as 4-MPD. COMPULSIVENESS: N-ethyl C5 pattern plus binge deaths. ENJOYMENT: not a beloved brand; a lab result.
substances.negatives_writeup: DEA 2019 Schedule I. Luxembourg Oct 2013 first as 4-methyl-N-ethylnorpentedrone. Polish tox six cases, wide blood range.

rush.rationale: Name-swap contaminates feel; N-ethyl C5 analogue of NEP.

cardiovascular.rationale: DEA overdoses on the 2019 list; Polish series.

substances.name: 4-fluoropentedrone
substances.one_liner: Two UK bags. No chorus.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: none on record. Alias 4-FP is a lab shorthand, not a street brand confirmed here.
substances.negatives_writeup: Forensic tick.

substances.name: 4-methylbuphedrone
substances.one_liner: Mephedrone’s α-ethyl stamp. 2011 shelf, not a legend.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: thin. Do not invent a meow sequel. Vendors later drew this structure on 4-MPD pages.
substances.negatives_writeup: Isomer of 4-MEC / pentedrone / NEB / 3,4-DMMC. Netherlands Sep 2011.

substances.name: 3,4-dimethylmethcathinone
substances.one_liner: NRG-era leftover. Third-generation after the first bans.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: meh. EUPHORIA: headshop leftover, not a modern ask. COMPULSIVENESS: moderate class. ENJOYMENT: low. Ring-dimethyl is the ‘branched’ here, not a chain fork.
substances.negatives_writeup: Hungary 13 Oct 2010. Polish tox one very high blood. ACMD third-generation list.

substances.name: 3,4-dimethylethcathinone
substances.one_liner: DMMC’s N-ethyl twin. On the EUDA board. Almost no stories.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: null. Monitored NEP isomer.
substances.negatives_writeup: Isomer collision.

substances.name: Mexedrone
substances.one_liner: They advertised it like meow. It wasn’t.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH: basically none. EUPHORIA: a few late posters describe a weak short calm glow; most of the Bluelight thread said inactive or sedating. COMPULSIVENESS: people complained, they did not fiend. ENJOYMENT: flop. α-methoxy mephedrone, not mephedrone.
substances.negatives_writeup: Roberts 2017: 11 confirmed polydrug ED cases — agitation, tachycardia, some hallucinations/paranoia, mostly gone in 24 h. UK still seeing bags years later.

rush.rationale: Bluelight flop thread; weak SRA pharmacology.

euphoria.rationale: Mostly dud; a few weak-glow posts.

paranoia.rationale: Some ED hallucinations/paranoia in polydrug cases.

aftereffects.rationale: Mostly gone in 24 h in Roberts.

substances.name: Metamfepramone
substances.one_liner: Old medicine-cabinet N,N-dimethyl. Not a party SKU.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: no street-era feel corpus worth scoring. Historical pharmaceutical / anorectic lineage, later NPS monitoring.
substances.negatives_writeup: DEA lists N,N-dimethylcathinone as a mephedrone positional isomer. Do not write a rave review.

substances.name: Benzedrone
substances.one_liner: N-benzyl, not N-alkyl. Same 2010 headshop week as 4-MEC.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: poor corpus. Included so the wall does not pretend N-ethyl is the only N-swap.
substances.negatives_writeup: UK 16 Aug 2010. Three UK detections 2020–23.

substances.name: 4-bromoethcathinone
substances.one_liner: Bromo-ethyl stamp on the EUDA board. No fan club.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: null.
substances.negatives_writeup: Name-board only in this pass.

substances.name: Iso-ethcathinone
substances.one_liner: 2010 Irish notification. Cathinone with the ketone walked.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: no feel card. Historical first-year legal-high example.
substances.negatives_writeup: Ireland 18 Jun 2010. Keep as forensic history, not a shelf star.

substances.name: 4-chloro-N,N-dimethylcathinone
substances.one_liner: UK seized it. Nobody reviewed it.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: null. 28 seized samples is a market tick, not a forum.
substances.negatives_writeup: Forensic only in this pass.

rush.rationale: UK seized samples, no feel corpus.

substances.name: 4-fluoro-N-isopropylnorpentedrone
substances.one_liner: Branched N on a pentedrone tail. EUDA listed. Silence after that.
substances.positives_writeup: RUSH / EUPHORIA / COMPULSIVENESS / ENJOYMENT: null. Documented name, not a story.
substances.negatives_writeup: Branched N-alkyl example. Do not invent homologues around it.
